lines.text: Oh. You don’t have to apologize for being honest. I just wasn’t expecting you to say it out loud like that.
lines.tts_spoken: Oh. You don’t have to apologize for being honest. [breath] I just wasn’t expecting you to say it out loud like that.

lines.text: It’s not bad. It’s just… a lot to feel through a phone screen while I’m at work.
lines.tts_spoken: It’s not bad. It’s just… a lot to feel through a phone screen while I’m at work.

lines.text: You’re not the only one who’s been a little distracted since last night. I keep thinking about the way you looked at me across the table. And now this.
lines.tts_spoken: You’re not the only one who’s been a little distracted since last night. [breath] I keep thinking about the way you looked at me across the table. And now this.

lines.text: I should probably get back to customers before I start blushing in front of them. But… I like that you’re telling me the truth.
lines.tts_spoken: I should probably get back to customers before I start blushing in front of them. [breath] But… I like that you’re telling me the truth.

lines.text: Ryan… You’re sitting in a meeting thinking about kissing me?
lines.tts_spoken: Ryan… [breath] You’re sitting in a meeting thinking about kissing me?

lines.text: That’s not fair. Now I’m standing behind the counter thinking about it too.
lines.tts_spoken: That’s not fair. [breath] Now I’m standing behind the counter thinking about it too.

lines.text: I don’t know what our first kiss would feel like yet. But the fact that you’re already wondering about it makes me want to find out.
lines.tts_spoken: I don’t know what our first kiss would feel like yet. [breath] But the fact that you’re already wondering about it makes me want to find out.

lines.text: And yes… If the moment feels right on Thursday, I’d let you.
lines.tts_spoken: And yes… [breath] If the moment feels right on Thursday, I’d let you.

lines.text: I should go before I say something even more honest. Talk later?
lines.tts_spoken: I should go before I say something even more honest. [breath] Talk later?

lines.text: Probably a good idea. For both of us.
lines.tts_spoken: Probably a good idea. For both of us.

lines.text: I’m already having enough trouble focusing without you making it worse.
lines.tts_spoken: I’m already having enough trouble focusing without you making it worse.

lines.text: Go survive your meeting. I’ll try to stop smiling at my phone every five minutes.
lines.tts_spoken: Go survive your meeting. [breath] I’ll try to stop smiling at my phone every five minutes.

lines.text: Talk later, Ryan. Looking forward to Thursday more than I should admit.
lines.tts_spoken: Talk later, Ryan. [breath] Looking forward to Thursday more than I should admit.

lines.text: Hey… Goodnight, Ryan. I’m glad you texted.
lines.tts_spoken: Hey… Goodnight, Ryan. [breath] I’m glad you texted.

lines.text: Empty houses feel louder than they should sometimes. I know that feeling. It’s strange how quiet can suddenly feel heavy.
lines.tts_spoken: Empty houses feel louder than they should sometimes. [breath] I know that feeling. It’s strange how quiet can suddenly feel heavy.

lines.text: You’re not the only one whose place feels a little different tonight.
lines.tts_spoken: You’re not the only one whose place feels a little different tonight.

lines.text: Sleep well, okay? I’ll be thinking about you.
lines.tts_spoken: Sleep well, okay? [breath] I’ll be thinking about you.

lines.text: Good morning… You’re calling me beautiful before I’ve even had coffee. That’s dangerous.
lines.tts_spoken: Good morning… [breath] You’re calling me beautiful before I’ve even had coffee. That’s dangerous.

lines.text: Good morning to you too, Ryan. I slept better than I expected… kept thinking about last night’s texts though.
lines.tts_spoken: Good morning to you too, Ryan. I slept better than I expected… [breath] kept thinking about last night’s texts though.

lines.text: How did you sleep?
lines.tts_spoken: How did you sleep?

lines.text: I kind of figured. You seem like the type whose mind doesn’t know how to sit still.
lines.tts_spoken: I kind of figured. [breath] You seem like the type whose mind doesn’t know how to sit still.

lines.text: Mine was quieter than usual last night, actually. That’s rare for me. I kept replaying pieces of our conversation in the shop… and the way you looked at me when you said you spent the night thinking about me.
lines.tts_spoken: Mine was quieter than usual last night, actually. That’s rare for me. [breath] I kept replaying pieces of our conversation in the shop… and the way you looked at me when you said you spent the night thinking about me.

lines.text: It’s a little scary how easily you’ve gotten into my head already.
lines.tts_spoken: It’s a little scary how easily you’ve gotten into my head already.

lines.text: Are you at work already, or do you get a slow morning?
lines.tts_spoken: Are you at work already, or do you get a slow morning?

lines.text: 4:30? Ryan… that’s not a morning, that’s a crime.
lines.tts_spoken: 4:30? Ryan… [breath] that’s not a morning, that’s a crime.

lines.text: Do you always start that early, or is your head still too full to sleep?
lines.tts_spoken: Do you always start that early, or is your head still too full to sleep?

lines.text: I’m about to open the shop. Already wishing the day would move faster so Thursday gets here sooner.
lines.tts_spoken: I’m about to open the shop. [breath] Already wishing the day would move faster so Thursday gets here sooner.

lines.text: Text me when you get a real break, okay? Even if it’s just to say you’re still alive after being up since before the sun.
lines.tts_spoken: Text me when you get a real break, okay? [breath] Even if it’s just to say you’re still alive after being up since before the sun.

lines.text: Overnight market numbers at 4:30 in the morning… That sounds exhausting. And very you, somehow.
lines.tts_spoken: Overnight market numbers at 4:30 in the morning… [breath] That sounds exhausting. And very you, somehow.

lines.text: I’m glad you’re alive. Would’ve been awkward if you’d disappeared before Thursday.
lines.tts_spoken: I’m glad you’re alive. [breath] Would’ve been awkward if you’d disappeared before Thursday.

lines.text: I’m about to unlock the door and let the first customers in. Already know I’m going to spend half the morning glancing at my phone like an idiot.
lines.tts_spoken: I’m about to unlock the door and let the first customers in. [breath] Already know I’m going to spend half the morning glancing at my phone like an idiot.

lines.text: Don’t work yourself into the ground before I get to see you again, okay?
lines.tts_spoken: Don’t work yourself into the ground before I get to see you again, okay?

lines.text: You’re not supposed to tell me that. Now I’m going to picture you sitting there between meetings, replaying everything… and it’s going to distract me even more than I already am.
lines.tts_spoken: You’re not supposed to tell me that. [breath] Now I’m going to picture you sitting there between meetings, replaying everything… and it’s going to distract me even more than I already am.

lines.text: I’ve been doing the same thing, if it makes you feel any better. Every quiet moment between customers I catch myself thinking about the rain, and the way you looked at me when you asked me to dinner… and how Thursday might feel.
lines.tts_spoken: I’ve been doing the same thing, if it makes you feel any better. [breath] Every quiet moment between customers I catch myself thinking about the rain, and the way you looked at me when you asked me to dinner… and how Thursday might feel.

lines.text: It’s a little dangerous how much space you’ve taken up in my head already.
lines.tts_spoken: It’s a little dangerous how much space you’ve taken up in my head already.

lines.text: I should go before I burn someone’s latte. But I’m really looking forward to seeing you, Ryan.
lines.tts_spoken: I should go before I burn someone’s latte. [breath] But I’m really looking forward to seeing you, Ryan.

lines.text: Yeah. I know that feeling.
lines.tts_spoken: Yeah. I know that feeling.

lines.text: Some of your messages do the same thing to me. That little drop in my stomach like the floor just shifted. I’m not used to someone getting under my skin this fast.
lines.tts_spoken: Some of your messages do the same thing to me. That little drop in my stomach like the floor just shifted. [breath] I’m not used to someone getting under my skin this fast.

lines.text: It’s a little scary. But I don’t want it to stop.
lines.tts_spoken: It’s a little scary. [breath] But I don’t want it to stop.

lines.text: Okay, I really do have to focus before I mess up an order. Talk later? And Ryan… I’m glad it’s you making my stomach do that.
lines.tts_spoken: Okay, I really do have to focus before I mess up an order. Talk later? [breath] And Ryan… I’m glad it’s you making my stomach do that.
